# pnpm.run runs a package's script with arguments, declares its outputs, and
# reruns when the package, a `workspace:` dependency of it, or an extra input
# changes, but not when an unrelated package does.
[!exec:pnpm] skip

bit
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ▶ pnpm --filter app run build --greeting hello$'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
stdout 'single │ path=packages/other/stamp\.txt$'
exists packages/other/stamp.txt
grep '\A\["--greeting","hello"\]\n\z' packages/app/dist/args.json
grep '\Ahello from lib v1\n\z' packages/app/dist/out.txt
grep '\Aconfig v1\n\z' packages/app/meta.txt

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

cp other.changed.js packages/other/index.js
bit
stdout 'stamp ✔ ok'
! stdout 'app ✔'

cp lib.changed.js packages/lib/index.js
bit
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
grep '\Ahello from lib v2\n\z' packages/app/dist/out.txt

cp config.changed.txt config/app.txt
bit
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
grep '\Aconfig v2\n\z' packages/app/meta.txt

cp build.changed.js packages/app/build.js
bit
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
grep '\Ahello from lib v2!\n\z' packages/app/dist/out.txt

bit --clean app
! exists packages/app/dist
! exists packages/app/meta.txt
exists node_modules

-- BUILD.bit --
deps = pnpm.install {}

app = pnpm.run {
  script     = "build"
  package    = "app"
  args       = ["--greeting", "hello"]
  outputs    = ["packages/app/dist", "packages/app/meta.txt"]
  inputs     = ["config/*.txt"]
  depends_on = [deps]
}

single = exec {
  command = "echo path=#{stamp.path}"
  inputs  = []
}

stamp = pnpm.run {
  script     = "stamp"
  package    = "other"
  outputs    = "packages/other/stamp.txt"
  depends_on = [deps]
}
-- pnpm-lock.yaml --
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .: {}

  packages/app:
    dependencies:
      lib:
        specifier: workspace:*
        version: link:../lib

  packages/lib: {}

  packages/other: {}
-- pnpm-workspace.yaml --
packages:
  - "packages/*"
-- package.json --
{ "name": "root", "private": true }
-- config/app.txt --
config v1
-- config.changed.txt --
config v2
-- packages/lib/package.json --
{ "name": "lib", "version": "1.0.0", "main": "index.js" }
-- packages/lib/index.js --
module.exports = "lib v1";
-- lib.changed.js --
module.exports = "lib v2";
-- packages/app/package.json --
{
  "name": "app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "scripts": { "build": "node build.js" },
  "dependencies": { "lib": "workspace:*" }
}
-- packages/app/build.js --
const fs = require("fs");
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const greeting = args[1];
fs.mkdirSync("dist", { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync("dist/args.json", `${JSON.stringify(args)}\n`);
fs.writeFileSync("dist/out.txt", `${greeting} from ${require("lib")}\n`);
fs.copyFileSync("../../config/app.txt", "meta.txt");
-- build.changed.js --
const fs = require("fs");
const greeting = process.argv.slice(2)[1];
fs.mkdirSync("dist", { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync("dist/out.txt", `${greeting} from ${require("lib")}!\n`);
fs.copyFileSync("../../config/app.txt", "meta.txt");
-- packages/other/package.json --
{ "name": "other", "version": "1.0.0", "scripts": { "stamp": "echo stamp > stamp.txt" } }
-- packages/other/index.js --
module.exports = "other v1";
-- other.changed.js --
module.exports = "other v2";
